meta.question: on CUB, at mean K=29, does allocating K in {12,49} per image by a student signal (entropy, confidence, attention concentration, margin) keep the masked teacher's TCKD lower than uniform K=29?
meta.method: keep-only masked teacher at several K per image; budget-matched two-level allocation by student uncertainty / attention concentration; paired bootstrap against uniform K
